name: read_service_map
description: Read the service map library (kept outside any session, in ~/.orwick/maps): which messages and calls connect a service with others. No service: list every map. A service: its docs, folder, related folders and question. A service and a name: that doc's Markdown. Read an existing map before updating it.

service.description: The map's name, e.g. orders or orders-refund; empty to list all

name.description: A doc's name, e.g. messages; empty to list the map's docs
